visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with glasses and a shiny gray sweater holds up a small acrylic keychain in a shop densely packed with stickers and photo booth memorabilia. She smiles broadly at the camera, looking directly into the lens while gesturing with her hands to show off the keychain's details. The setting is a brightly lit retail store with walls covered in stickers and photo strips. (2) The camera transitions to a series of close-up shots focusing on various sticker albums and photo booth output samples. The camera pans across pages filled with colorful, nostalgic-style photo stickers featuring celebrities. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy textures of the stickers and the varied patterns of the organizing folders. (3) The woman uses a handheld camera to show a long line of students waiting outside the shop, which is labeled 'PICKMYCCD'. The camera pans across the queue, showing many young people standing in an indoor shopping mall hallway with white walls and fluorescent overhead lighting. (4) Interior shots show a pink photo booth and shelves stocked with accessories like hats, glasses, and microphones for customers to use. The woman and a friend are seen inside the booth taking photos. (5) The final segment shows the woman presenting the completed products, including shiny laminated photo stickers and acrylic keychains, while sitting in a brightly lit indoor area with her red handbag nearby.
